title: C01 executable eligibility inventory
sourcePlanTask: TASK-002 — Package eligibility and characterization inventory

scope.candidateUniverse: Eight recorded Go package patterns resolved with go list.
included: go test top-level test identities and source locations
APP-002 application-owned witness, dependency, fidelity, classification, and migration-group rows
deferred: remote/paid provider validation and unavailable platform/environment edges

packageResolution.command: For each `$pattern` in the eight patterns: `go list $pattern`.
packageResolution.propertyProved: Go tooling resolved the exact 39-package denominator at the recorded commit.
packageResolution.propertyNotProved: The package list alone does not prove test behavior or migration safety.

testListing.propertyProved: Every resolved package has a Go-discovered top-level test list; zero-test packages are explicit facts.
testListing.propertyNotProved: `go test -list` does not execute test bodies.

raceEvidence.propertyProved: The shared relationship package executes with race instrumentation; TestSharedServerRelationships exercises one root-built server, isolated explicit Factory Sessions, controlled mock-worker gates, public Work projections, and Factory Event ordering.
raceEvidence.propertyNotProved: Non-relationship eligibility/classification, complete timing, remote provider behavior, and migration parity.
raceEvidence.diagnosticReference: Terminal JSON package event was pass; all 12 named TestSharedServerRelationships subtests were pass.

timingEvidence.sampleProcedure: For each package: run `go clean -testcache`, then direct `go test -json -short -p=1 -parallel=2 $package -count=1 -timeout=5m` three sequential times.
timingEvidence.failurePolicy: Failed, skipped, timed-out, or diagnostically incomplete samples remain recorded and are never replaced.

externalDecisions.description: Canonical reference-CI machine for timing comparison is not repository-owned by C01.
Whether timing budgets block immediately or begin as observation is not repository-owned by C01.
